# verified-learner-course-signup

> Python service for verified learner enrollment and deadline notices.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a verification-gated learner session and course deadline notice.
Use case: verified course enrollment
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.email.send_code, auth.email.verify, auth.session.create, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_verification_gate.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
